The week

Needing footage, fast

This week I needed some footage that I thought would be easy to get from AI. I was excited to show off Hailuo AI, so I tried a simple prompt. I was also looking for an AI to tween with.

1 · Animated footage from AI

About 90% of the image-to-video work I've done has turned out well, so I thought I'd try a cartoon. Easy, right? I used two different images for two different angles, with the prompt: Ship approaches slo-mo rotating planet. Cartoon style animation.

2 · The easy way: old-school cel animation

  1. I took some screenshots of the Animated Series.
  2. Photoshop: made PNGs of the ships.
  3. Illustrator: made two PNGs of space with the planet in frame.
  4. Illustrator: a simple gradient strip for the planet surface. No Keylight needed.
  5. After Effects: assembly. Every image is a rectangle, like a cel. I stacked them and animated them the way animators used to.

3 · A surprise "recreate" prompt

Running "recreate" on an existing image from the home page gave an unexpected clip. The prompt: The Vulcan man with a beard and blue uniform with a ceremonial sash embellished with medals turns his head to look into the camera. In front of the Vulcan is a huge glass screen covered in numbers and patterns of various colors. Through the glass screen, the Vulcan can be seen smiling at the camera.
